anti_patterns.symptom: Doing too much action in too short a space of time.
anti_patterns.why_bad: The action flashes by too fast for the audience to register it, losing readability and weight.
anti_patterns.fix: Go twice as slow. Add in cushioning drawings at the beginning and end to slow the action down.

anti_patterns.symptom: Providing a timing chart that leaves the assistant to calculate three evenly spaced inbetweens.
anti_patterns.why_bad: It compounds spacing errors and turns fluid arcs into wobbly, all-over-the-place movements.
anti_patterns.fix: The animator should draw one of the inbetweens themselves, leaving the assistant to divide the remaining gap exactly in half.

anti_patterns.symptom: Placing an inbetween exactly in the mathematical middle of a contact action, such as a ball falling or a mallet hitting a nail.
anti_patterns.why_bad: The object begins to squash, distend, or bend while still floating in the air, before the actual impact.
anti_patterns.fix: The change in shape must only take place exactly on the contact frame.

anti_patterns.symptom: Inbetweening organic limb movements in a perfectly straight line between two extremes.
anti_patterns.why_bad: The bones appear to shrink in length at the midpoint, destroying the natural, continuous flow of the action.
anti_patterns.fix: Ensure the path of action follows a continuous arc or figure-8, dragging the wrist or joint along the curve [4, 5].
anti_patterns.detect_heuristic: midpoint_position == lerp(extreme_A, extreme_B) AND joint_type != mechanical

anti_patterns.symptom: Tracing or animating a walk where the head and body move horizontally in a smooth, level line.
anti_patterns.why_bad: The character appears to float weightlessly; weight cannot be conveyed by smooth level movement.
anti_patterns.fix: Accentuate and exaggerate the up and down positions of the masses. Make the body mass drop on the bent leg to feel the weight.

anti_patterns.symptom: Animating the arm swing to reach its widest spread exactly on the foot's contact position.
anti_patterns.why_bad: It looks stiff and mechanical, ignoring the natural pendulum momentum of the body balancing the thrust of the leg.
anti_patterns.fix: Delay the arm swing so it is at its widest on the 'down' position, which occurs after the contact position.

anti_patterns.symptom: Applying perfect repetitive cycles of circles or figure-8s to the body and head action during a standard walk.
anti_patterns.why_bad: It results in an unnatural, mechanical loop that resembles a pigeon or bird walking.
anti_patterns.fix: Keep the main body mass mostly straight up and down for safety, avoiding perfect looped patterns on the head.
